query: Where is the Department for Registration of Persons head office?

hits.text: --- title: National Identity Card — Fees and Services source_url: https://drp.gov.lk/en/assets/downloads/fees-english.pdf source_org: Ministry of Public Security, Department for Registration of Persons (DRP) notice_date: 2022-11-01 accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # National Identity Card — Fees and Services ## English The Department for Registration of Persons (DRP) is at 10th Floor, Suhurupaya, Sri Subuthipura Road, Battaramulla.

Processing fees: - Normal service: LKR 10,000.00 - Urgent (one-day) service: LKR 20,000.00 The one-day service is only available at the Head Office in Battaramulla. Applications for the one-day service are accepted between 7.00 a.m. and 1.30 p.m. on weekdays. Overseas applicants apply through Sri Lankan diplomatic missions using the same K-35A form. Required documents include the National Identity Card, the previous passport (for renewals), and two recent passport-size photographs that meet the prescribed specifications.

--- title: Passport — Issue and Renewal source_url: https://www.immigration.gov.lk/pages_e.php?id=8 source_org: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka language: en/si/ta accessed: 2026-05-27 --- # Passport — Issue and Renewal ## English The Department of Immigration and Emigration issues passports to Sri Lankan citizens. The printed application form K-35A is used for new and renewal applications and can be collected from the Department or downloaded from the website.

Revised fees effective from 1 November 2022: - Registration and issuance of NIC for the first time: LKR 200 - Issuance of an amended copy of NIC: LKR 500 - Issuance of a duplicate of a lost NIC: LKR 1000 - Issuance of a new NIC replacing one with expired validity: LKR 200 - One-day service surcharge (added to the application fee): LKR 2000 - Translation of NIC to English: LKR 2000 - Certifying particulars in an NIC (bank or state institution request): LKR 500 - Certifying particulars in an NIC (personal request): LKR 1000 Applications are accepted at the area Divisional Secretariat office.

hits.text: --- title: Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service source_url: https://web.erl2.gov.lk/ secondary_url: https://www.gov.lk/services/erl/es/erl/view/index.action source_org: Department of Motor Traffic / Provincial Councils, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service (eRL) ## English The eRL service is the official online portal for vehicle revenue licence renewal in Sri Lanka. The supported vehicle categories include Motor Cars, Motor Cycles, Dual Purpose Vehicles, Land Vehicles, Three Wheelers, and other classes maintained by the Department of Motor Traffic.

How the service works: - First-time users sign up on web.erl2.gov.lk before logging in. - The user enters the vehicle number and the last 6 digits of the chassis number to confirm ownership. - A valid Insurance Certificate is required. A Vehicle Emission Test Certificate is required for vehicle categories where it applies. - The system accepts credit and debit card payments only. hits.text: --- title: Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service source_url: https://web.erl2.gov.lk/ secondary_url: https://www.gov.lk/services/erl/es/erl/view/index.action source_org: Department of Motor Traffic / Provincial Councils, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service (eRL) ## English The eRL service is the official online portal for vehicle revenue licence renewal in Sri Lanka. The supported vehicle categories include Motor Cars, Motor Cycles, Dual Purpose Vehicles, Land Vehicles, Three Wheelers, and other classes maintained by the Department of Motor Traffic.

How the service works: - First-time users sign up on web.erl2.gov.lk before logging in. - The user enters the vehicle number and the last 6 digits of the chassis number to confirm ownership. - A valid Insurance Certificate is required. A Vehicle Emission Test Certificate is required for vehicle categories where it applies. - The system accepts credit and debit card payments only. After payment confirmation, a temporary printable licence valid for 14 days is sent by email.

hits.text: --- title: National Identity Card — Fees and Services source_url: https://drp.gov.lk/en/assets/downloads/fees-english.pdf source_org: Ministry of Public Security, Department for Registration of Persons (DRP) notice_date: 2022-11-01 accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # National Identity Card — Fees and Services ## English The Department for Registration of Persons (DRP) is at 10th Floor, Suhurupaya, Sri Subuthipura Road, Battaramulla.

Revised fees effective from 1 November 2022: - Registration and issuance of NIC for the first time: LKR 200 - Issuance of an amended copy of NIC: LKR 500 - Issuance of a duplicate of a lost NIC: LKR 1000 - Issuance of a new NIC replacing one with expired validity: LKR 200 - One-day service surcharge (added to the application fee): LKR 2000 - Translation of NIC to English: LKR 2000 - Certifying particulars in an NIC (bank or state institution request): LKR 500 - Certifying particulars in an NIC (personal request): LKR 1000 Applications are accepted at the area Divisional Secretariat office.

--- title: Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service source_url: https://web.erl2.gov.lk/ secondary_url: https://www.gov.lk/services/erl/es/erl/view/index.action source_org: Department of Motor Traffic / Provincial Councils, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service (eRL) ## English The eRL service is the official online portal for vehicle revenue licence renewal in Sri Lanka. The supported vehicle categories include Motor Cars, Motor Cycles, Dual Purpose Vehicles, Land Vehicles, Three Wheelers, and other classes maintained by the Department of Motor Traffic.

Processing fees: - Normal service: LKR 10,000.00 - Urgent (one-day) service: LKR 20,000.00 The one-day service is only available at the Head Office in Battaramulla. Applications for the one-day service are accepted between 7.00 a.m. and 1.30 p.m. on weekdays. Overseas applicants apply through Sri Lankan diplomatic missions using the same K-35A form. Required documents include the National Identity Card, the previous passport (for renewals), and two recent passport-size photographs that meet the prescribed specifications.

The supported vehicle categories include Motor Cars, Motor Cycles, Dual Purpose Vehicles, Land Vehicles, Three Wheelers, and other classes maintained by the Department of Motor Traffic.

How the service works: - First-time users sign up on web.erl2.gov.lk before logging in. - The user enters the vehicle number and the last 6 digits of the chassis number to confirm ownership. - A valid Insurance Certificate is required. A Vehicle Emission Test Certificate is required for vehicle categories where it applies. - The system accepts credit and debit card payments only. After payment confirmation, a temporary printable licence valid for 14 days is sent by email.

hits.text: --- title: Dengue — patient guidance source_url_1: https://www.dengue.health.gov.lk/web/index.php/en/information/instructions-for-patients source_url_2: https://www.epid.gov.lk/storage/post/pdfs/fact_sheet_on_dengue_for_primary_care_doctors.pdf source_org: National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU) & Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Dengue — patient guidance ## English Recommended medication for fever and pain: use Paracetamol only, at the dose prescribed by your doctor.

Do NOT use Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) such as Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Diclofenac Sodium, Mefenamic Acid, or Celecoxib (tablets or syrup) to reduce fever, because these drugs increase the risk of bleeding. Seek immediate medical attention if any warning signs appear: - persistent vomiting, - severe abdominal pain, - bleeding from the gums, nose, or in stools, - restlessness, lethargy, or cold extremities, - a sudden drop in temperature accompanied by sweating.

--- title: Seasonal influenza — public guidance source_url: https://www.epid.gov.lk/web/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=171:dengue-update&catid=51:message-for-public&Itemid=487&lang=en source_org: Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka note: Public-health guidance summarised from Epidemiology Unit communications. accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Seasonal influenza — public guidance ## English Influenza is a viral infection. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Misuse of antibiotics for viral illnesses contributes to antimicrobial resistance, a public-health concern that the Ministry of Health has highlighted in successive advisories.

Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes mosquito breeding sites: empty and scrub water-holding containers at least once a week, cover all stored water, and dispose of discarded tyres, tins, and plastic items that collect rainwater. Seek medical attention if symptoms last longer than 7 days, if breathing becomes difficult, or if a high fever persists beyond 3 days. ## සිංහල (summary) ඉන්ෆ්ලුවෙන්සා (උණ) වෛරස් රෝගයකි; ප්රතිජීවක ඖෂධ එයට ප්රතිකාරයක් නොවේ. රෝග ලක්ෂණ දින 7 කට වඩා පවතී නම් හෝ හුස්ම ගැනීමේ අපහසුතා ඇත්නම් වෛද්ය උපදෙස් ලබාගන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) இன்ஃப்ளுயன்சா ஒரு வைரஸ் தொற்று; நுண்ணுயிர் எதிர்ப்பிகள் இதற்கு சிகிச்சை அளிக்க மாட்டாது. அறிகுறிகள் 7 நாட்களுக்கு மேல் நீடித்தால் அல்லது சுவாசிக்கக் கடினமாக இருந்தால் மருத்துவ உதவியை நாடவும்.

Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes mosquito breeding sites: empty and scrub water-holding containers at least once a week, cover all stored water, and dispose of discarded tyres, tins, and plastic items that collect rainwater. Home remedies (papaya leaf juice, lime juice, herbal preparations) are not proven cures for dengue and must not replace medical care. ## සිංහල (summary) ඩෙංගු සාථකව උෂ්ණත්වය හා වේදනාව පාලනය සඳහා පාරසිටමෝල් පමණක් භාවිතා කරන්න.

Do NOT use Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) such as Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Diclofenac Sodium, Mefenamic Acid, or Celecoxib (tablets or syrup) to reduce fever, because these drugs increase the risk of bleeding. Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes mosquito breeding sites: empty and scrub water-holding containers at least once a week, cover all stored water, and dispose of discarded tyres, tins, and plastic items that collect rainwater. query: What are the warning signs that require immediate medical attention in dengue?

hits.text: Early warning signs that require immediate action include: - new cracks in walls, floors, or the ground, - doors or windows that suddenly start sticking, - tilted trees or fences, - water seeping from unusual locations on a slope. Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes mosquito breeding sites: empty and scrub water-holding containers at least once a week, cover all stored water, and dispose of discarded tyres, tins, and plastic items that collect rainwater. Do NOT use Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) such as Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Diclofenac Sodium, Mefenamic Acid, or Celecoxib (tablets or syrup) to reduce fever, because these drugs increase the risk of bleeding. hits.text: Key milestones from the national immunization schedule: - BCG vaccine: administered at 0 to 4 weeks of age, before the newborn leaves the hospital, often within 24 hours of birth. - Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib) vaccine: administered in the infancy series. - MMR vaccine: a national MMR Catch-up Immunization Programme was launched on 6 January 2024 by the Epidemiology Unit, targeting children aged 9 months to 15 years who missed their routine MMR doses.

A child should not be vaccinated when they have a fever above 38 degrees Celsius on the day of the appointment. The vaccination should be rescheduled with the MOH clinic. Mild low-grade fever and soreness at the injection site within 24 to 48 hours are normal post-vaccination reactions. ## සිංහල (summary) ශ්රී ලංකාවේ ජාතික එන්නත් වැඩසටහන (EPI) 1978 දී ආරම්භ කරන ලදී. BCG එන්නත උපතේ සිට සති 4 ක් ඇතුළත දෙනු ලැබේ.

query: When should antenatal care begin in pregnancy?

hits.text: A pregnant woman is expected to have at least 8 antenatal clinic visits with a skilled healthcare provider and 3 or more home visits by the PHM during the pregnancy. Iron and folic acid supplementation is provided to nearly all pregnant women in Sri Lanka; a 2016 national survey found that 98 percent of women with a recent live birth had taken iron pills or capsules during pregnancy. ## සිංහල (summary) ගර්භණී සමයේ පළමු වෛද්ය පරීක්ෂාව සති 12 කට පෙර ආරම්භ කිරීම සුදුසු වේ. ශ්රී ලංකාවේ පූර්ව ප්රසව සත්කාරය නිවසේ පෞද්ගලික සෞඛ්ය මාතාව (PHM) මගින් සහ සායන වෛද්යවරයන් මගින් ලබා දේ.

A child should not be vaccinated when they have a fever above 38 degrees Celsius on the day of the appointment. The vaccination should be rescheduled with the MOH clinic. Mild low-grade fever and soreness at the injection site within 24 to 48 hours are normal post-vaccination reactions. ## සිංහල (summary) ශ්රී ලංකාවේ ජාතික එන්නත් වැඩසටහන (EPI) 1978 දී ආරම්භ කරන ලදී. BCG එන්නත උපතේ සිට සති 4 ක් ඇතුළත දෙනු ලැබේ.

Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Misuse of antibiotics for viral illnesses contributes to antimicrobial resistance, a public-health concern that the Ministry of Health has highlighted in successive advisories.

General precautions during flu season: - Stay home if you have flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat). - Cover coughs and sneezes with a tissue or the elbow. - Wash hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds, especially after coughing, sneezing, or touching shared surfaces. - People in high-risk groups (children under 5, adults over 65, pregnant women, and people with chronic respiratory or metabolic conditions) should consider the seasonal influenza vaccine, which is available privately.

Do NOT use Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) such as Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Diclofenac Sodium, Mefenamic Acid, or Celecoxib (tablets or syrup) to reduce fever, because these drugs increase the risk of bleeding. Seek immediate medical attention if any warning signs appear: - persistent vomiting, - severe abdominal pain, - bleeding from the gums, nose, or in stools, - restlessness, lethargy, or cold extremities, - a sudden drop in temperature accompanied by sweating.

A child should not be vaccinated when they have a fever above 38 degrees Celsius on the day of the appointment. The vaccination should be rescheduled with the MOH clinic. hits.text: Seek medical attention if symptoms last longer than 7 days, if breathing becomes difficult, or if a high fever persists beyond 3 days. ## සිංහල (summary) ඉන්ෆ්ලුවෙන්සා (උණ) වෛරස් රෝගයකි; ප්රතිජීවක ඖෂධ එයට ප්රතිකාරයක් නොවේ. රෝග ලක්ෂණ දින 7 කට වඩා පවතී නම් හෝ හුස්ම ගැනීමේ අපහසුතා ඇත්නම් වෛද්ය උපදෙස් ලබාගන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) இன்ஃப்ளுயன்சா ஒரு வைரஸ் தொற்று; நுண்ணுயிர் எதிர்ப்பிகள் இதற்கு சிகிச்சை அளிக்க மாட்டாது. அறிகுறிகள் 7 நாட்களுக்கு மேல் நீடித்தால் அல்லது சுவாசிக்கக் கடினமாக இருந்தால் மருத்துவ உதவியை நாடவும்.

Iron and folic acid supplementation is provided to nearly all pregnant women in Sri Lanka; a 2016 national survey found that 98 percent of women with a recent live birth had taken iron pills or capsules during pregnancy. ## සිංහල (summary) ගර්භණී සමයේ පළමු වෛද්ය පරීක්ෂාව සති 12 කට පෙර ආරම්භ කිරීම සුදුසු වේ. ශ්රී ලංකාවේ පූර්ව ප්රසව සත්කාරය නිවසේ පෞද්ගලික සෞඛ්ය මාතාව (PHM) මගින් සහ සායන වෛද්යවරයන් මගින් ලබා දේ.

ඉබුප්රෝෆන්, ඇස්පිරින්, ඩික්ලොෆිනැක් වැනි NSAID ඖෂධ භාවිතා නොකරන්න; රුධිර වහනය වැඩි කිරීමේ අවදානම ඇත. දිගටින් වමනය, දැඩි බඩ වේදනාව, විදුරුමස් වලින් රුධිර වහනය වැනි අනතුරු ලක්ෂණ පෙනේ නම් වහා වෛද්ය ආධාර ලබාගන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் மற்றும் வலிக்கு வைத்தியர் பரிந்துரைத்த அளவில் பாராசிட்டமாலை மட்டுமே பயன்படுத்தவும். ஐபுபுரோஃபன், அஸ்பிரின், டிக்லோஃபெனாக் போன்ற NSAID மருந்துகளைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டாம்; இரத்தப் போக்கின் ஆபத்து அதிகமாகும். தொடர்ச்சியான வாந்தி, கடுமையான வயிற்று வலி, ஈறுகளில் இரத்தப்போக்கு போன்ற எச்சரிக்கை அறிகுறிகள் தோன்றினால் உடனடியாக மருத்துவ உதவியைப் பெறவும்.

## සිංහල (summary) ජාතික ගොඩනැගිලි පර්යේෂණ සංවිධානය (NBRO) පසුගිය පැය 24 ක වර්ෂාපතනය 75 mm ඉක්මවන විට කහ (මට්ටම 1) භූමි කඩාවැටීම් අනතුරු ඇඟවීම නිකුත් කරයි. නාය යාම් රෝග ලක්ෂණ දකින්නේ නම් වහා ආරක්ෂිත ස්ථානයකට ඉවත් වන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) தேசிய கட்டிட ஆராய்ச்சி ஸ்தாபனம் (NBRO) கடந்த 24 மணி நேரத்தில் மழைப்பொழிவு 75 மிமீ ஐ தாண்டும்போது மஞ்சள் (நிலை 1) நிலச்சரிவு எச்சரிக்கையை வெளியிடுகிறது. கடுமையான நிலச்சரிவு அறிகுறிகள் தென்பட்டால் உடனடியாக பாதுகாப்பான இடத்திற்கு வெளியேறவும்.

query: What are early warning signs of a landslide on the ground?

hits.text: Early warning signs that require immediate action include: - new cracks in walls, floors, or the ground, - doors or windows that suddenly start sticking, - tilted trees or fences, - water seeping from unusual locations on a slope. If severe landslide signs are observed, the public should promptly inform the relevant authorities and evacuate to a safer place to avoid the risks.

- Yellow (Level 1) warning: when rainfall in the previous 24 hours exceeds 75 mm, the public should be aware of the possibility of landslides, slope failures, rock falls, cut-slope failure, and ground subsidence, and should be prepared to evacuate to a safe location if necessary. Special attention should be paid to all hilly areas, to man-made cut-slope roads within the affected districts, and in particular to all landslide-prone sites previously designated by NBRO.

query: How much drinking water should I store per family member before a cyclone?

hits.text: - Store at least three days of drinking water per family member, and charge mobile phones and power banks once a warning is issued. - Keep important documents in a waterproof container, and pack a small emergency kit (medication, identification copies, torch, first-aid). hits.text: ## සිංහල (summary) ජාතික ගොඩනැගිලි පර්යේෂණ සංවිධානය (NBRO) පසුගිය පැය 24 ක වර්ෂාපතනය 75 mm ඉක්මවන විට කහ (මට්ටම 1) භූමි කඩාවැටීම් අනතුරු ඇඟවීම නිකුත් කරයි. නාය යාම් රෝග ලක්ෂණ දකින්නේ නම් වහා ආරක්ෂිත ස්ථානයකට ඉවත් වන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) தேசிய கட்டிட ஆராய்ச்சி ஸ்தாபனம் (NBRO) கடந்த 24 மணி நேரத்தில் மழைப்பொழிவு 75 மிமீ ஐ தாண்டும்போது மஞ்சள் (நிலை 1) நிலச்சரிவு எச்சரிக்கையை வெளியிடுகிறது. கடுமையான நிலச்சரிவு அறிகுறிகள் தென்பட்டால் உடனடியாக பாதுகாப்பான இடத்திற்கு வெளியேறவும்.

සෑම පවුල් සාමාජිකයෙකුට දින 3 ක් සඳහා පානීය ජලය ගබඩා කරන්න. සුළි කුණාටුවේ ඇස ගමන් කරන විට මිනිත්තු 20–30 ක නිශ්චල කාලයක් පැමිණේ; පිටතට නොයන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) வளிமண்டலவியல் திணைக்களம் (Department of Meteorology) புயல் எச்சரிக்கைகளை வெளியிடுகிறது. ஒவ்வொரு குடும்ப உறுப்பினருக்கும் 3 நாட்களுக்கு போதுமான குடிநீரை சேமிக்கவும். புயலின் கண் கடக்கும் போது 20–30 நிமிட அமைதியான நேரம் இருக்கலாம்; வெளியே செல்ல வேண்டாம்.

අවම වශයෙන් සායන 8 ක් සහ නිවස තුළ 3 ක් හෝ ඊට වැඩි පරීක්ෂණ අවශ්ය වේ. ## தமிழ் (summary) கர்ப்பத்தின் முதல் மருத்துவ பரிசோதனை 12 வாரங்களுக்கு முன்னர் தொடங்க பரிந்துரைக்கப்படுகிறது. இலங்கையில் கர்ப்பக் கால பராமரிப்பு பொது சுகாதார மருத்துவச்சி (PHM) மற்றும் மருத்துவ அதிகாரிகள் வழியாக வழங்கப்படுகிறது. குறைந்தது 8 கிளினிக் சந்திப்புகள் மற்றும் 3 அல்லது அதற்கு மேற்பட்ட வீட்டு சந்திப்புகள் அவசியம்.

MMR Catch-up වැඩසටහන 2024 ජනවාරි 6 සිට ආරම්භ විය. දරුවාට දින 38°C ට වැඩි උෂ්ණත්වය ඇත්නම් එම දින එන්නත නොකරන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) இலங்கையின் தேசிய நோய்த்தடுப்பூசி திட்டம் (EPI) 1978 இல் தொடங்கப்பட்டது. BCG தடுப்பூசி பிறப்பிலிருந்து 4 வாரங்களுக்குள் வழங்கப்படுகிறது. MMR Catch-up திட்டம் 2024 ஜனவரி 6 இல் தொடங்கப்பட்டது. குழந்தைக்கு அந்த நாளில் 38°C க்கு மேல் காய்ச்சல் இருந்தால் தடுப்பூசி வழங்கக் கூடாது.
